aboutText: Automation-driven Senior QA Engineer / SDET with 7+ years building and scaling test automation across web, desktop, API, and hardware platforms. I build and maintain automated suites with Selenium, Playwright, Java, Python, and TypeScript, wire them into CI/CD quality gates on Jenkins, TeamCity and Azure DevOps, and write API coverage in code with REST Assured. I work shift-left: risk-based test strategy, early defect detection, containerized runs with Docker, reliable test data, and AI-assisted test design with Codex and GitHub Copilot. Agile/Scrum collaborator working closely with developers and Product Owners, remote-first, and fluent in English.
